source_snapshot.items: In-band firmware upgrade/downgrade using NVFlash for GPU and NVSwitch
source_snapshot.procedure: Run one nvflash VBIOS file against all GPU/NVSwitch then read versions.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: One VBIOS file conflates distinct components and direction.

old_problem: One VBIOS placeholder cannot safely define both GPU and NVSwitch targets; upgrade versus downgrade, images, ordering and recovery are absent.
disposition_reason: Component-image compatibility and target semantics are core command meaning, not mere IDs. ED-07/12 prohibit a blanket flash or cross-crediting upgrade and downgrade.
decision_basis: Preserved GPU and NVSwitch plus both directions as distinct coverage.

test_case.test_name: In-band GPU and NVSwitch firmware upgrade/downgrade matrix
test_case.purpose: Execute separately authorized GPU and NVSwitch upgrade/downgrade cases with component-correct images and recovery.
test_case.test_command: Do not run blanket source command. After approval, execute one component and one direction at a time, capture pre/task/post versions, activate as specified and verify full topology health.
test_case.expected_result: Each separately authorized target reaches its direction-specific version and all GPUs/NVSwitch links remain healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: One file or tool exit cannot prove both component classes or both directions.
test_case.recovery: Use component-specific rollback and OOB recovery; never continue to another target after failure.

source_conflict.reason: One VBIOS placeholder conflates GPU and NVSwitch plus two directions.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Define component images/targets, directions, nvflash semantics/order and recovery.
